services.name: Kealakekua Bay OE1
services.desc: Duration Approx. 4 hr. Encounter (8:30am-12:30pm) About Ocean Encounters Kealakekua Bay Strap on your snorkel gear and get ready to jump into the warm waters for the swim of a lifetime. Departing from Honokohau Harbor, join us for this 4 hour morning reef snorkel while we motor down the beautiful Kona Coast to Kealakekua Bay, one of Hawaii’s most renowned marine sanctuaries. Kealakekua Bay is a protected bay, widely regarded as some of the best snorkeling in Hawaii!! Keep your eyes open for spinner dolphins known to use this famous bay as their resting grounds.
